{{Top}}
[[File:The_Load_Lifters_Drummer.png|thumb|250px|The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] drummer of The [[Load Lifters]] in the [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] [[Junix's Joint|Cantina]].]]
A [[Drum/Legends|drum]] was an instrument that was played with other musicians in a [[Band/Legends|band]] to create music.

==History==
Members of the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]], [[Ak-rev/Legends|Ak-rev]] and [[Umpass-stay/Legends|Umpass-stay]], played large tan hide drums in [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].

After the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] defeated the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] ground forces at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], some of the Ewoks fashioned a drum set from the helmets of Imperial troops.
